# The exact environment the YuE2 music engine was measured in, hash-pinned.
#
# A `uv pip freeze` of the `uv sync --frozen` environment built from the port's own `uv.lock` at
# 9253ed133343406947bde7b67d43c7a63fb39d99, minus the `mlx-yue` package itself — that is installed
# from the pinned checkout, `--no-deps`, so this file is the only resolver. Every wheel hash below
# comes from PyPI's own metadata for that exact version.
#
# **Why a third runtime.** `mlx-Yue` pins `mlx==0.32.2` while the Voice runtime (and therefore the
# Music overlay built on it) carries `mlx==0.31.2`. The port's Metal SDPA kernels and its `mlx_lm`
# usage are pinned to the version its author validated, and one tree cannot hold two `mlx` versions,
# so YuE2 gets its own interpreter — the same conclusion the video lane reached with its two engines.
